description: A React component implementing a dashboard interface with tab management, viewport control, and inspector integration, including WebSocket communication with a backend server.

classes.name: Dashboard
classes.description: React functional component for the dashboard interface, managing tabs, viewport, and inspector controls.

methods.name: tabFavicon
methods.description: Generates a favicon character based on the hostname of a URL.

methods.name: imgCoords
methods.description: Calculates image coordinates relative to the viewport for mouse events.

methods.name: sendMouseEvent
methods.description: Sends mouse events ('mousedown' or 'mouseup') to the channel with calculated coordinates.

methods.name: onScreenMouseDown
methods.description: Handles mouse down events on the viewport, toggling interactivity or sending events.

methods.name: onScreenMouseUp
methods.description: Handles mouse up events on the viewport, sending the event if interactive.

methods.name: onScreenMouseMove
methods.description: Handles mouse move events, throttled, sending coordinates to the channel.

methods.name: onScreenWheel
methods.description: Handles wheel events, forwarding delta values to the channel.

methods.name: onScreenKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down events, including escape to cancel locator picking.

methods.name: onScreenKeyUp
methods.description: Handles key up events, forwarding key presses.

methods.name: onOmniboxKeyDown
methods.description: Handles Enter key in URL input, navigating to the entered URL.
